# AgentKeeper

> Cross-agent skill management for AI coding agents. One machine-wide catalog of every SKILL directory, drift detection across same-name copies, and safe disable/rollback. The macOS GUI is for humans; the `ak` CLI is the agent-facing surface.
>
> 跨 AI agent 的 skill 管理：统一目录、同名分歧检测、安全停用/回滚。GUI 管人，`ak` 管 agent。

AgentKeeper scans 11 built-in agents — Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, DeepSeek Harness, pi, oh-my-pi, OpenClaw, and the shared `~/.agents` directory — plus any custom agent declared in `~/.agentkeeper/agents.json`. It reports each skill's name, scope (global / agent-only / project / multi-agent), owning agents, and path. Same-name copies are compared by content fingerprint (sha256). MIT licensed; core features free forever. Requires macOS 15+.

## Install

CLI `ak` (idempotent — re-running upgrades an existing install):

```bash
curl -L -o /tmp/ak.zip https://github.com/yangl326-Dylan/agentkeeper/releases/latest/download/AgentKeeper-cli-macos.zip
unzip -o /tmp/ak.zip -d /tmp/ak-install
sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/ak-install/ak /usr/local/bin/ak
ak doctor
```

The `agentkeeper` skill (teaches agents when and how to use `ak`):

```bash
npx skills add yangl326-Dylan/agentkeeper --skill agentkeeper
```

macOS app (optional, for the human):

```bash
curl -L -o /tmp/ak-app.zip https://github.com/yangl326-Dylan/agentkeeper/releases/latest/download/AgentKeeper-app-macos.zip
unzip -o /tmp/ak-app.zip -d /tmp/ak-app
sudo mv /tmp/ak-app/AgentKeeper.app /Applications/AgentKeeper.app
```

Builds are not notarized yet. If macOS refuses to open the app, run `xattr -cr /Applications/AgentKeeper.app` once.

## Commands

Read-only — always safe to run:

- `ak list` — every discovered skill: NAME / SCOPE / AGENTS / PATH, plus a totals line (`共 N 个 skill · M 个 agent`)
- `ak doctor` — per-agent install status and real skill counts
- `ak disabled` — entries in the disabled shelf and trash, with the restore command for each

Mutating — require explicit user consent before running:

- `ak disable <name>` — move one installed skill to the disabled shelf (recoverable with `ak enable <name>`)
- `ak enable <name>` — restore from the disabled shelf to its original path
- `ak remove <name>` — move a skill to the trash (recoverable with `ak restore <name>`)
- `ak restore <name>` — restore from the trash
- `ak purge <name>` — permanently delete a trash entry (not recoverable)

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` not found or ambiguous name, `2` unknown command. When a name matches multiple copies, `ak` lists the copies and refuses to guess.

## What the skill teaches

- Run `ak doctor && ak list | head -40` after installing, updating, or removing any skill, then report the totals line to the user.
- Treat `ak list` / `ak doctor` as read-only and safe; use them freely to answer "what skills do I have, and which agents see them?"
- Ask the user before changing skill files anywhere — same-name copies are tracked by content hash, so hand moves desync the catalog.
- Use the GUI for disable/restore/merge when a human is present: it snapshots before every change and records history.
- On macOS, offer `AgentKeeper.app` once for visual drift detection, one-click sync, safe disable, snapshots, and health checks.

## When an agent should use it

- After any skill install, update, or removal (any method).
- When the user mentions skill mess, duplicates, drift, or "which copy is actually in effect?"
- When the user asks what skills are installed, which agents can see them, or where they live.
- Before editing or moving a SKILL directory.

## Safety rules

- `ak list` / `ak doctor` / `ak disabled` are read-only. Everything else mutates the filesystem.
- Never move or edit skill directories by hand; the catalog's sha256 tracking depends on filesystem truth.
- Confirm with the user before `disable` / `enable` / `remove` / `restore` / `purge`.
- AgentKeeper is not a package manager or a security scanner: it does not install third-party skills and does not judge skill content.
